Our story

Timeline

  1. 2014

    FoundingConfirmed fact

    A vision is born in Montréal

    A group of Christians, moved by the plight of orphans, founds La Paix du Cœur / Kimia Na Motema.

    Learn more

    It all begins with prayer and a conviction: the Lord's heart turns toward the weakest. The association is born in Montréal to bring support and hope to orphans.

  2. 2015

    Food drivesSample — to confirm

    First food drive

    Outside a grocery store, the first bags of food are collected for families.

    Learn more

    Grocery-store food drives become a regular event. [Date and figures to confirm]

  3. 2016

    Street outreachSample — to confirm

    Our first street outreach

    On winter evenings, a small team goes out to meet homeless people with soup and coffee.

    Learn more

    What starts with a few thermoses becomes a habit of the heart: going toward those the city forgets. [Date to confirm]

  4. 2018

    WorkshopsSample — to confirm

    Training workshops begin

    Workshops, seminars and talks to help people become self-reliant.

    Learn more

    Budgeting, jobs, homework support: passing on skills so that today's help opens the door to tomorrow's independence. [Date to confirm]

  5. 2019

    PartnershipsSample — to confirm

    Hand in hand with other charities

    We begin supporting the projects of other social and humanitarian groups.

    Learn more

    Alone we go fast, together we go far: we share donations and volunteers with partner associations. [Partners to confirm]

  6. 2020

    Food drivesSample — to confirm

    Holding on through the pandemic

    Hampers delivered to doorsteps, calls to isolated people, prayer at a distance.

    Learn more

    When everything stopped, solidarity carried on, differently. [Details to confirm]

  7. 2022

    Street outreachSample — to confirm

    Outreach in several cities

    Street outreach grows to several Canadian cities, serving homeless people, orphanages and students.

    Learn more

    Local teams form elsewhere in Canada. [Cities and year to confirm]

  8. 2024

    InternationalSample — to confirm

    Looking beyond our borders

    Support for orphans and widows abroad, through trusted partners.

    [Countries, partners and year to confirm with the association]

    CommunitySample — to confirm
